units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 7. Repealed from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.label: Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 1. A civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by the relevant normative legal act of the Russian Federation must submit to the employer's representative the expenditure information required by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, in the manner established by federal law and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 2. Correspondence between the expenditure and income of a civil servant, their spouse and minor children is monitored in the manner established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 3. A civil servant's failure to submit the expenditure information required by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’ where submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Submission of information on expenditure
units.text: 4. A civil servant's submission of knowingly inaccurate information referred to in part 3 of this Article is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
units.text: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
units.label: Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
units.text: 1. Information on the addresses of websites and/or website pages on the Internet information and telecommunications network on which a citizen seeking a civil service position or a civil servant has posted publicly accessible information, and data enabling their identification, is submitted to the employer's representative by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
units.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position, upon entry into service, for the three calendar years preceding the year of entry into the civil service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
units.text: 2) a civil servant, annually for the calendar year preceding the year in which the information is submitted, except where publicly accessible information was posted in the performance of the civil servant's official duties.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
units.text: 2. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted by citizens seeking civil service positions upon entry into the civil service, and by civil servants no later than 1 April of the year following the reporting year. The information specified in part 1 of this Article is submitted using the form established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Submission of information on posting information on the Internet information and telecommunications network
units.text: 3. By decision of the employer's representative, civil servants authorized by that representative process publicly accessible information posted on the Internet information and telecommunications network by applicants for civil service positions and civil servants, and verify the accuracy and completeness of the information provided for by part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information
units.text: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information
units.label: Art. 20.3

units.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information
units.text: 1. On entering the civil service, a citizen submits a questionnaire using the form established by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.3

units.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information
units.text: 2. A civil servant notifies the employer's representative in writing of changes in the information in the questionnaire that become known to the civil servant.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.3

units.locator: Article 20.3. Submission of a questionnaire, notification of changes to information in it and verification of that information
units.text: 3. Information in the questionnaire may be verified by decision of the employer's representative or a person authorized by that representative. The state body's personnel service verifies it by sending written requests to public authorities and organizations possessing the relevant information, including through state information systems, among them those provided for by Article 44.1 of this Federal Law. Public authorities and organizations possessing the relevant information must provide the requested information no later than one month after receipt of the request.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.3

units.locator: Chapter 4. ENTRY INTO THE CIVIL SERVICE
units.text: Chapter 4. ENTRY INTO THE CIVIL SERVICE
units.label: Chapter 4. ENTRY INTO THE CIVIL SERVICE

units.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: 1. Citizens of the Russian Federation who have reached 18 years of age, know the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements established by this Federal Law are entitled to enter the civil service.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: 2. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 317-ФЗ of 29.11.2010.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Right to enter the civil service
units.text: 3. A citizen may not be admitted to the civil service in the cases provided for by points 1–9, 11 and 12 of part 1 of Article 16 of this Federal Law. Other restrictions on entry into the civil service are established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.label: Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 1. Unless otherwise established by this Article, a citizen enters the civil service to hold a civil service position, or a civil servant takes another civil service position, on the basis of a competition. The competition consists of assessing the professional level of applicants, checking compliance with other established qualification requirements for the position, and selecting from among the applicants, on the basis of that assessment and check, a citizen or civil servant for appointment to the position.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 2. No competition is held:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 1) on appointment to fixed-term civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 2) on appointment to civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category for which appointment and removal are carried out by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 3) when concluding a fixed-term service contract;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 4) when appointing a civil servant by transfer to another civil service position in the cases provided for by points 3–14 of part 5 and points 3–5 of part 6 of Article 28 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 5) when appointing to a civil service position a civil servant or citizen included in the civil service personnel reserve.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 3. A competition may be omitted for appointment to particular civil service positions whose duties involve the use of state secrets, according to a list of positions approved by a normative act of the state body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 4. By decision of the employer's representative, a competition may be omitted for appointment to positions in the junior group of civil service positions, and in other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 5. An applicant for a civil service position may be refused admission to a competition for failure to meet the qualification requirements for the vacant position or because of restrictions established by this Federal Law on entry into and performance of the civil service.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 6. An applicant for a civil service position who is not admitted to a competition may challenge that decision in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 7. A competition commission is established by a legal act of the relevant state body to conduct a competition for a vacant civil service position.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 8. The competition commission includes the employer's representative and/or civil servants authorized by that representative (including from the subdivision responsible for state service and personnel and the subdivision where the vacancy is being filled), and independent experts included under part 8.2 of this Article: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations specializing in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activity, personnel technologies and civil service matters. Independent experts must constitute at least one-quarter of the total membership of the commission.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 8.1. In a federal executive body with a public council established under Article 20 of Federal Law No. 32-ФЗ of 4 April 2005 ‘On the Public Chamber of the Russian Federation’, and in an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation with a public council established under a normative legal act of that constituent entity, representatives of those public councils are included in the competition commission alongside the persons specified in part 8 of this Article. The combined number of those representatives and independent experts must be at least one-quarter of the commission's total membership.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 8.2. Representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations included in competition commissions are invited and selected, at the employer's representative's request made without specifying the independent experts' personal data, by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and normative legal regulation in the state civil service, or by an authorized state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation. This is done in the manner established by a normative legal act of the Government of the Russian Federation or a normative legal act of a constituent entity adopted with regard to the procedure established by the Government. Public council representatives included in competition commissions are designated by decisions of the respective public councils.
units.label: Part 8.2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 8.3. An independent expert's total period on a state body's competition commission may not exceed three years. The period is calculated from the expert's first inclusion in the commission. The same independent expert may be included again no earlier than three years after the end of their period on the commission.
units.label: Part 8.3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 8.4. An independent expert's combined period on the competition and attestation commissions of the same state body may not exceed three years.
units.label: Part 8.4 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 9. A competition commission for a vacant civil service position whose duties involve use of state secrets is formed with regard to the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 10. The competition commission is formed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could influence its decisions.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 11. An applicant for a civil service position may challenge the competition commission's decision in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Entry into the civil service and appointment to a civil service position through competition
units.text: 12. Regulations on competitions for vacant state civil service positions of the Russian Federation, determining the procedure and conditions for them, are approved by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 22

units.locator: Chapter 5. SERVICE CONTRACT
units.text: Chapter 5. SERVICE CONTRACT
units.label: Chapter 5. SERVICE CONTRACT

units.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract
units.text: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract
units.label: Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract is an agreement between the employer's representative and a citizen entering the civil service or a civil servant concerning performance of civil service and holding a civil service position. The service contract establishes the parties' rights and duties.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract
units.text: 2. The employer's representative undertakes to give a citizen entering the civil service the opportunity to perform civil service and to give that citizen or a civil servant the opportunity to hold a specified civil service position; to ensure performance of civil service and holding of the position in accordance with this Federal Law, other laws and other normative legal acts on civil service; to pay the civil servant's monetary remuneration promptly and in full; and to provide state social guarantees.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Definition and parties to a service contract
units.text: 3. A citizen entering the civil service, when concluding a service contract on performance of civil service and holding a civil service position, and a civil servant, when concluding a service contract on holding a civil service position, undertake to perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations and observe the state body's service rules.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.label: Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract states its date and place of conclusion; the name of the state body; the employer's representative's position, surname, given name and patronymic (if any); the title, date and number of the legal act determining that representative's legal status and authority to conclude the service contract; the surname, given name and patronymic (if any) of the citizen or civil servant appointed to the civil service position; and details of that person's identity document.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 2. The terms of a service contract include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 1) the title of the civil service position held, specifying the state body's structural subdivision (if any) and the place of service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 2) the date of commencement of official duties and the duration of the service contract;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 3) the civil servant's rights, duties and liability under this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts on civil service, and the official duties regulations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 4) the types and conditions of the civil servant's medical insurance and other types of insurance;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 5) the employer's representative's rights, duties and liability under this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts on civil service;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 6) conditions of professional service activity, and compensation and benefits for professional service activity in arduous, harmful and/or dangerous conditions;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 7) the working and rest time arrangements, if they differ for the civil servant from the state body's service rules;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 8) remuneration terms (the civil servant's official salary, supplements and other payments, including those related to the effectiveness of professional service activity), as established by this Federal Law, other federal laws and other normative legal acts;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 9) types and conditions of social insurance connected with professional service activity;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 10) inclusion of the position held by the civil servant in the list of civil service positions for which rotation of civil servants is provided;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 11) probation, if provided for by Article 27 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 12) nondisclosure of state secrets, other secrets protected by federal law and official information, if the official duties regulations provide for the use of such information;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 13) the person's obligation, after completing education at a vocational education organization or a higher education organization, to perform civil service for no less than the period established by the targeted education agreement, if the education was funded by the relevant budget;
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 24
